NTi XL2 specifications (research pass, search summaries 2026-11-12): a balanced XLR measurement input (on top, 48 V phantom), an RCA input, a mini-B USB port, a 3.5 mm headphone output and a DC socket; a first summary also listed a TOSLINK output, which a second summary did not repeat. The Bêta proposal keeps all five ports, so the TOSLINK stays on the model but is not documented; beta-modelled. 90 x 180 x 45 mm (datasheet, size ok). Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened.
